name: Moddy Arena
intro: Welcome to Moddy Arena! You are in the prep room. The arena is past the gate.
Get ready in the prep room: make things, then put them on your hotbar. Open one in My wishes and press Add to hotbar.

The battle arena control panel is on the wall: pick the difficulty and the waves, then press START BATTLE. When a wave comes the gate shuts and you are taken into the arena. Only your hotbar wishes work in a battle, and you have 3 lives. The Champions board is on the back wall.

book.title: Arena Guide
book.author: Moddy
pages:
Welcome to
Moddy Arena!

Get ready in the prep room. When a wave comes, the gate shuts with bars and you are taken into the arena.

In a break it opens.

The control panel

The panel on the prep room wall sets up your battle:
DIFFICULTY: how hard, and how many monsters
WAVES: how many

Then press START BATTLE!

Waves

Monsters come in waves. Beat them all to clear a wave.

Every {arena_boss_every} waves comes a BOSS WAVE, with a big boss and its helpers!

Lives

You have {arena_lives} lives in a battle.

Knocked out? You go back to the prep room with your hotbar. Soon you are back in the arena!

Breaks

After a wave there is a break of {arena_break_seconds} seconds. After a boss wave it is {arena_boss_break_seconds} seconds.

The bar at the top counts it down.

READY

In a break, the START BATTLE button says READY.

Press it when you want the next wave to come sooner.

The arena mends

In every break the arena fixes itself: holes fill in, and things your wishes built go away.

Your creatures stay.

Making wishes

Make your wishes in the prep room, with the Builder or the Apprentice. They are free!

Stronger wishes

A battle starts with creatures of up to {arena_ladder_health} hearts and hits of up to {arena_ladder_hits} hearts.

Clear waves to make wishes stronger!

The wish ladder

In a battle, events open after {arena_ladder_events_open}.

The WISH LADDER board by the panel shows what wishes can have now, and what comes next. A new battle starts again.

Magician wishes

A Wish Magician can make {arena_magician_wishes} Magician wishes between two battles.

Your hotbar

Open My wishes on your watch, pick a wish and press Add to hotbar.

In a battle, only the wishes on your hotbar work.

Firing a wish

In a battle, hold a wish on your hotbar and use it.

Then it rests for {arena_rest_seconds} seconds before you can use it again.

Wishes a wave

You can fire {arena_wishes_per_wave} hotbar wishes in each wave. You get them all back in the next wave.

The bar at the top shows how many are left.

Creatures help!

A creature you wish into the arena helps in a battle:

Fighter: it fights the monsters.

Healer: it stays near you and heals you.

Tank: the monsters chase it and leave you alone.

Champions

The best battles go on the Champions board on the back wall.

_notes: The world's manifest, as its jar ships it: gameplay only (no hostnames, ports, machines or briefs). intro: the first-join words, said once per player per world by the core a few seconds after he arrives in the prep room. guide.book: the Arena Guide, a written book the core gives on his first arrival and on /moddy guide; a {key} on a page is a rules number the arena's charge hands the core (ArenaGuide), and a page whose number a rule turns off is left out.
